> Web Aura India is a Hyderabad-based web development studio founded by five co-founders —
> Sriman, Rohith, Santosh, Gopal, and Ronith. We build high-performance, SEO-optimised
> websites and intelligent digital systems for businesses across India and internationally.
> Our core stack is Next.js. Our work spans conversion-led marketing sites, AI-driven
> marketing automation, workflow digitalisation, and enterprise web platforms.

## Identity

- Company name: Web Aura India (also known as Web Aura Innovations)
- Type: Web development studio and digital agency
- Founded: 2025
- Location: Hyderabad, Telangana, India
- Website: https://www.webauraindia.in
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/_webaura/
- LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/company/webaura-technologies/

## Co-Founders

- Sriman — Product & Execution Strategist. Translates client goals into clear project plans, structured workflows, and measurable delivery milestones.
- Rohith — Experience & Interface Architect. Designs intuitive, conversion-optimised user interfaces and visually distinctive web experiences.
- Santosh — Client Growth Strategist. Identifies business opportunities, manages client relationships, and drives agency growth.
- Gopal — Systems & Reliability Architect. Designs and maintains core technical infrastructure to ensure performance, uptime, and scalability.
- Ronith — Operations & Brand Manager. Handles internal coordination, documentation, and brand consistency across all touchpoints.

## Core Services

- Next.js Website Development: High-performance marketing sites and web applications built with Next.js for speed, SEO, and scalability.
- SEO-Optimised Websites: Technical SEO, Core Web Vitals optimisation, structured data, and content architecture baked into every build.
- AI Marketing Systems: Intelligent, AI-driven marketing operations that automate lead generation, personalisation, and customer engagement at scale.
- Workflow Automation: Digitalising business operations by automating complex workflows and reducing manual overhead through AI and software integrations.
- Digital Infrastructure: Scalable online platforms and enterprise-grade web infrastructure tailored for performance and security.
- AI Strategy & Integration: Helping businesses identify and implement AI across their operations for measurable efficiency gains.
- Revenue-Based Growth Engagements: Partnership-first model where Web Aura's success is tied to measurable client outcomes and ROI.

## Primary Audiences

- Startups in India seeking a conversion-led website from a trustworthy agency
- SMBs and founders in Hyderabad needing local web development expertise
- Businesses across India wanting Next.js development with built-in SEO
- Enterprises looking for AI marketing automation and workflow digitalisation
- International clients wanting Indian agency rates with world-class delivery quality

## What Makes Web Aura Different

- Five-founder team covering strategy, design, engineering, systems, and client growth — not a one-person freelance shop
- Next.js-first stack: server-side rendering, static generation, and incremental static regeneration chosen per project for optimal SEO and speed
- Conversion and SEO baked in from discovery — not bolted on after design
- Technical SEO baselines, analytics-ready events, and documented handover included in every launch
- Clear milestones, transparent pricing, and client-owned code, hosting, and domains

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: What is Web Aura India?
A: Web Aura India is a Hyderabad-based web development studio founded by five co-founders. We build high-performance, SEO-optimised websites and AI-driven digital systems for businesses across India and globally. Our primary stack is Next.js.

Q: Where is Web Aura located?
A: Web Aura is based in Hyderabad, Telangana, India. We work with clients across India and internationally.

Q: What services does Web Aura offer?
A: We offer Next.js web development, SEO-optimised website design, AI marketing automation, workflow digitalisation, digital infrastructure engineering, and AI strategy and integration.

Q: How much does a website cost at Web Aura?
A: Pricing depends on scope — complexity, design depth, integrations, and timeline. A focused marketing site typically falls in a lower-to-mid five-figure INR range for SMB scopes. Custom apps, dashboards, and AI integrations cost more. Web Aura quotes after a discovery call so every line item maps to a deliverable.

Q: How long does a web development project take?
A: Most marketing sites take 4–12 weeks from kickoff to launch when content and approvals move at pace. Larger builds with custom integrations run on milestone plans that may span multiple months.

Q: What technologies does Web Aura use?
A: Next.js (primary), React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, headless CMS platforms, and AI/automation integrations. Stack choice is matched to project requirements — not one-size-fits-all.

Q: Does Web Aura only work with clients in Hyderabad or India?
A: No. While based in Hyderabad, Web Aura works with clients across India and internationally. All work is remote-first with clear async communication.

Q: Who owns the code and hosting after a project?
A: Clients own all code, design assets, and hosting accounts from day one. Web Aura documents handover clearly at launch.

Q: How is Web Aura different from a freelancer?
A: Web Aura is a five-founder studio — not a solo operator. UX design, frontend engineering, backend systems, SEO, and client strategy are handled by dedicated specialists. Projects include discovery, milestones, technical SEO baselines, analytics setup, and post-launch handover.

Q: Can Web Aura help with AI and automation — not just websites?
A: Yes. AI marketing systems and workflow automation are core services. Web Aura helps businesses identify AI opportunities, implement automations, and build intelligent digital infrastructure alongside or independent of website work.
